text.p: Liverpool striker Robbie Fowler was charged with misconduct by the Football Association (F.A.) on Tuesday over his sending off against Everton last month.
Fowler, Liverpool's top scorer in the premier league this season with 18 goals, was dismissed after clashing with Everton defender David Unsworth at Goodison Park on April 16.
The England striker is serving a three-match ban for the sending off in the 1-1 draw.
Fowler was banished eight minutes from time, together with Unsworth, for violent conduct after the two exchanged punches.
They also appeared to square up to one another again as they walked off the pitch after being shown the red card.
